issues.on_page: Miscellaneous 8,434 = Visitors Promotion Fund 3,934 + Visitors Improvement Fund 4,500 (combining statement p12)
issues.issue: The combining statement shows that all of the nonmajor 'Miscellaneous' spending comes from the two visitor promotion (tourism) funds, so 'economic development' (tourism) fits better than a guessed general government. The same 8,434 is inside the statement's 'Miscellaneous General' 1,705,835 (disbursements[5]).

The report doesn't name the tax. Treating it as lodging tax because it is in the visitor promotion funds is a reasonable assumption (already marked review). The statement-level 'Taxes' line includes these 11,980 as taxes (unlabeled).
